company_info.company_description: "At I Want Energy, you receive the kind of quality and service you expect from a leader. Our company is always evolving as the needs or our customers change and as new opportunities are created in the market. You can rest assured that, working with I Want Energy, you will enjoy the latest services, technology and developments in the industry."

reviews.review_description: The process and communication was seamless from beginning to end.  Highly recommended.  My install was not straight forward, but the team accepted the challenge, came up with an innovative solution.  Brilliant!

'I want energy' provided good and frank advice ... this was really appreciated. The sales/quoting process was hassle free.The installation went well noting we have a concrete tiled roof on an old house.  Polite, Tidy, and PunctualThe installer helped organise the grid connection after the install, and showed me how to use the cool 'iSolarCloud' app.

My install will happen in 5 weeks time.  Slower than Solar quotes expected based on the frequent requests for a review :)  The “delays” are all of my making.  But I am so excited by what is planned to be installed, and that I am working with a team who pride themselves in their integrity and knowledge.  My investment will be significantly bigger than I had first thought.  Inspired largely by the “smarts” and “future proofing” of the system that integrates with having a three phase supply to the property with a phase supplying each of the three main buildings.   Yes the design does mean adding eaves to increase the roof length of the building these panels are being installed on by 0.8 m to maximise panels without triggering special planning requirements.  But this is something easily done by me.   I’ve gone for the much bigger battery so that even if the sun is not shining sufficiently, I should never have to pay peak power costs.   And the system is grid ready for when Oz EV beaurocracy eventually “matures”.

Of the three quotes obtained through SolarQuotes, one was keen to install a basic system (fair enough; but we wanted a bit more), one was very good (and found the battery location we ended up using) but didn't include all the sundries in the quote, and one was a bit more expensive but seemed very thorough.The third was the one we went with: the somewhat non-euphoniously named I Want Energy.The salesman/designer (Ian) was excellent, right from the initial contact, through the initial proposal, on the site visit, through the modifications and onto the final specification.We were somewhat constrained in choice of components, as we have three phase, wanted a DC-coupled battery, wanted full blackout protection, and didn't like the vibes from Sigenergy. We have a complicated roof, so the panel layout was not simple. We could possibly have squeezed one more panel up there, but that would have meant a bigger inverter - something pointed out and advised against as uneconomic by Ian.Once things were under way, their Accounts and Admin person (Lynne) was startlingly efficient. She was submitting the paperwork for permits, work orders and loans as fast as I could deal with them. Nothing was missed. If only every company worked so well!There was then a bit of a delay, because *someone* had announced (the day after we got started!) there should be a rebate on batteries. So it took a little longer to get the installation booked in.When they did arrive, the installation crew was fantastic: very punctual and very courteous, and with clearly the correct attitude to safe working at heights (including lots of temporary roof anchors). They'd also scheduled two days, which was what it took. And they were keen to  investigate a really neat solution I thought I'd found for the cable run, even though it turned out to be not possible. The final installation was exceptionally neat. Of course we were paying for this, but the professionalism was worth it.And then there was another delay, as The Rebate Rules meant we couldn't commission the system until 1 July. But we were booked in for early that week ... until the actual more onerous commissioning rules were published and (as far as I can tell) the company found themselves overcommitted. It was during this period communication from the company was not as good as I'd hoped.Even though there were some complications around the grid connection which I needed some assurance about, I was really struggling to get any response from them. I get it: they (and by implication us) had gambled on what the Rebate Rules would be, and were then overwhelmed by how much work was actually needed. In the meantime our installation photos had appeared on their Facebook page (so at least we knew they were still trading ...).I doubt any of the other companies could have provided better times, except by chance. And I'm very happy with the components and the installation.

From the beginning of the process I found I Want Energy to be very informative and professional. The installation was very professional and all the workers were efficient and friendly. I would recommend this company and to enjoy the benefits of a contemporary and upgraded solar system.

I have had two solar installations over the past few years and have recently had an EV charger installed.The quote, install and service was top notch. We did have an issue at the very beginning which was sorted and fixed asap. I highly recommend this Tasmanian team.

The initial quotation process was seamless and easy; The front-of-house staff is nothing short of exceptional.Although our installation experienced a few hiccups due to the Polystyrene render cladding, the team quickly identified a solution and implemented it. Any requests I had were quickly actioned.Even had a visit from the GM + Owner to ensure everything was set right and that the outcome he promised had been delivered. This is what customer service is all about.

The whole process with I Want Energy was fantastic - they were down to earth and gave me information in plain language, making it easy to make a decision. The installers were fantastic and respected our property. Overall very happy with the process.

Knowledgeable, trustworthy ,dependable, reliable and personable at all times. In time of need, Alex’s feedback and response (.,along with his team at ‘I Want Energy’ in Moonah)was WAY beyond my hopes and expectations-brilliant!
The whole process went far beyond my expectations.  I will be recommending them to everyone.

Sales and quoting process was honest and open.Installation was very professional.Post installation grid connection was all handled by themThere were a couple of hitches post installation which were dealt with promptly.Thank you for your guidance. Without which, I would not have had the confidence to proceed.
Most detailed quoting, Sales guy very knowledgeable and helpful to me
I Want Energy is great to deal with and they suggested a solar system matching our needs and also difficult installation on our steep and tiled roof.

After extensive research and discussion with numerous providers (which resulted in four quotes) we decided on a system that met our needs and was within our budget and arranged installation for 31/01/2025.The installers arrived on time but very quickly realised the Inverter could not be positioned according to the provider's design due to lack of clearance around the unit. After a stressful discussion we reluctantly agreed to an alternative location and work commenced.  This location is in full sun so the unit will require a heat shield significantly larger than the Inverter itself. This will be retro fitted when available.Some time later it was discovered that not all the solar panels would fit according to the design so again, reluctantly, we agreed that three panels could be positioned on another section of roof at a 90 degree angle to the remainder.The system is working and it will be interesting to monitor its performance after the unplanned modifications.

Overall, the experience was very positive. There were a few challenges, but the company addressed them all and was easy to deal with.The sales process was a bit rushed, with a limited time to accept the quote before the price increased by $2,000, but the sales manager was very helpful.Installation went really well. Good communication, and very neat job. The tech took our specific concerns into account and were able to adapt their installation to our needs.  After sales service has been fantastic.Not the cheapest option, but they have a long track record, and we chose them for reliability over price.

I Want Energy are a great company to work with. The quoting process was quick and easy and on site. the installation of two TESLA powerwall  batteries was neat and only took 5 hours. All the staff that I had interactions with seemed to know their business and the systems they were installing. I would highly recommend using I Want Energy for any solar, battery or EV charging installations.

Starting with the first meeting to discuss options, the I Want Solar rep, Ed was brilliant. Funny, extremely knowledgeable, honest about costs, detailed but not tedious in explanation. Between the original quote and actually signing up for the install, a number of months went by, and Ed remembered everything we had discussed, and came back to me with an even better option than originally quoted. After committing, the communications with Lynn were straightforward and clear, and the install itself went extremely smoothly. After a day of running, it appeared there was a problem with part of the system and when I called, Alex checked the output remotely, and had the installers come straight back out the next morning to fix the problem (some wiring on one aspect was not functioning) All the guys that came to do the install were polite and cheerful, even on two chilly Rokeby mornings. Since the second visit the system has worked even better than I hoped. The app is straightforward and easy to negotiate, (and fascinating to watch!) and when I got back in touch with Alex at I Want Energy tech support, he offered to monitor the system and check in with me after a month to make sure I’m getting the best out of the battery-solar set up.Ed, the original rep. has been in touch to check in and ask how I’m enjoying the system, and has now also helped select an ev charger, now that I am replacing my petrol car with an ev.I really couldn’t be happier with everyone and everything at I Want Energy!
They arrived at the site at the date and time they predicted.  Were very efficient and had the job done in the time specified.

The extra cable I needed to join the shed to the house seemed to throw a spanner in the works.Initially this trench was going to include a network lead to join the inverters.I am an IT guy and wanted to put a network lead in the channel for some POE stuff I am planning (cameras and network extensions)Following up to find out if this was OK, I was told the WIFI would be suffcient, OK - that is trueCan I put a conduit with a pull through in the same trench?This caused me to make 3 follow up calls with the supplier, none of which were answered. talking to the contractor at the job he had been asked a cryptic question that had not been clarified.Talking to him on site, we got the extra conduit laid int eh same trench, with some CAT5 as a pull through.So it worked out - but a little frustrated.

The quoting process with I Want Energy was very smooth (we had previously lived off grid, so pretty much knew what we wanted). Ed was very helpful and patient even through quite a few iterations of quotes.The installation team was great. Punctual, friendly, efficient and helpful (took pics with our camera of the installed panels since they were on a second storey roof). The installation was very neat and everything was left clean and tidy. Rob configured it all and ensured everything was working before they left.The admin team also did all the necessary paperwork for a Tas Renewables Loan as well as TasNetwork grid connection and advising our electricity retailer of the requirement to modify the configuration of our Smart Meter for a Feed in Tariff.Very glad we went with I Want Energy. They are an extremely professional solar company and I couldn't be happier.

We have just had our system installed and we are super happy with the entire process.  After having many other solar quotes, we found Ian listened to our needs and helped us decide on a system right for us and pointed us in the right direction to get the Tas Networks power  stuff arranged. The install date came around very quick and the team on the day (6 guys) all worked super well to get the whole thing up and running in a few short hours.  We were making power that arvo and feeding back into the grid next day.A well oiled team at I want Energy. Well done.

We discussed with Abi the best best panel requirements for our needs given we are in our late 70’s and just 2 of us. There was no sales pitch just straight out information/suggestions and a final quote. After final discussions we decided on the Sungrow panels and inverter at 9.6 kw (we have a EV) with a cost of around  $12.4K.A date was set and 4 guys arrived on time and did the complete 22 panel installation in about 6 hrs, we only have a 10deg slope on our roof which made it a bit easier. When they left the electronics was all sorted and the panels were producing. 24 hrs later Aurora had done their bit and we were receiving our feed-in tariff.If you want a professional job done speak to ‘I Want Energy’, highly recommended.

I want energy are a great company to deal with you can see by their quick response to questions raised in the quotation and installation process they plan on being around for the long term.Ian was the only rep to get on the roof and check things out. He explained the pros and cons of all the system options.

The sales/quoting process was very information.  Abby was fantastic.  She was patient, friendly, explained things very well - no question was a dumb question.  The installation appeared to go ahead without any hickups.  Robert was a great communicator managing the installation and friendly and approachable.  The team were punctual and polite.  The grid connection was organised by Robert with a simple text link for me to activate and download the app.  Topped off by a personal visit from the Manager.

The quoting process went very well. Everything was explained simply and so was the pricing.Of course, top products were more expensive and lesser efficient products less expensive, both were available.The installation, which was a tricky one, went very smoothly and efficiently over 1.5 days. Yes, they were all punctual and tidied up after themselves. All three guys were very nice, polite and cheerful.Everything was organised - I was told who I had to contact, and they did all the rest. My solar panels were up and running when they left and I was shown how to check the system.I would be pleased to recommend ‘I Want Energy’.I wondered why one of the original three companies you suggested to me said Solar could not be fitted at my house, too difficult for them maybe?
Easy to do with  seems to know what there talking about and they understand of my needs

I want energy was great! They actually listened to what I wanted and quoted me for a system that suited my needs. The installation was much quicker then I thought it would be and everything was done really neatly.I would definitely recommend them!

Everything went smooth and quickly, I am very happy with the install.I'd like to thank Edward Guglielmino for how helpful he was. He explained everything to make it make sense. He even helped out other family members with their solar as well.

Very professional and quality installation. Will recommend I Want Energy to anyone looking for quality solar installation.Sales processThe sales person (Edward) was very knowledgeable and not pushy. Gave me various options with full transparency on each item and cost. Went up on the roof to assess and proposed a good designInstallationKushal and team were very polite and diligent in their job. The installation looks beautiful. They were careful to put the cables and inverter in a non-conspicuous location on the side wall, even if it meant more work for them. Patiently explained to me the usage and app integration. ExcellentCustomer ServiceThe service (Lynn) was prompt and follow ups to any queries were quick. They followed up with the grid connection on the same day as the installation, and I can see the solar credits in my Aurora bills on the same day.

I Want Energy provided a face to face number of options and costs after doing a site inspection including roof measurement, identifying a solution for fitting required components into the full switchboard, and providing options in locating the inverter which was not possible next to the meter box. The system designer, Josh, was very helpful and not pushy at all. We were impressed with how thorough he was in discussing our requirements and providing well detailed quotes for various configurations.Their quote was very competitive with other companies and in the end we decided I Want Energy provided the best value for money considering all the requirements for installation. A Fronius Primo Gen24 was suggested with a free smart meter. We also went with a hot water timer and PV Point attached to the inverter.I Want Energy provided excelled communication throughout the process, keeping us informed and providing documentation of the system components.Derwent Electrical as subcontractors installed the system. They did a fantastic job, very neat and clean and the system was generating later that afternoon. They set me up with Fronius Solar.Web (I have paid for the premium version) and I find this great.

The most thorough quote, discussed all aspects of installation, including location of the inverter. Actually went on the roof.Were very responsive in replying to questions.Very polite, punctual installation team. Inverter was installed on the same day as panels.
Very professional from the very start to completed installation. would highly recommend great Team of people.

The initial quoting process was clearly explained and we felt confident the system suggested was the best one to meet our needs. Follow up questions were answered quickly and the time frame was shorter that originally scheduled. The installers were extremely competent and friendly. Follow up issues with wifi compatibility were quickly resolved in a very supportive manner.

I could not have asked for a better experience, from the sales consultant visit to our home discussing our requirements, doing a physical site assessment, and providing detailed quotes for two different sized systems the next day, through sales support keeping me up to date on the install schedule and quickly responding to my enquiries, to the install team who were punctual, neat, tidy, and delivered on schedule.Post commissioning there was a minor feed-in vs. self consumption monitoring problem (not the revenue meters) which was quickly corrected by the install team the next day.It is early days but system performance matches the proposals estimate for the current month.Several neighbours have commented on the neat unobtrusive install and asked who did the work, I didn’t hesitate to recommend I Want Energy.I Want Energy organised the required coucil build approval (30 panels) and grid connection
Not yet installed so cannot comment on installation process or customer service.
salesman was organized and had a professional attitude, good advice, punctual. all the administration with the power authority was arranged.

We had four quotes and chose I want Energy because of the professional presentation of the system by the salesman (Alex)A laptop was used to show the potential savings and costs using a variety of panels.He got up on the roof and had a closer look which enabled him to identify a potential issue.System installed in time frame stated using one of their trusted contractors, tricky due to our pitched roof but they did a great jobLess than two days after installation we were making electricityThe app is great and I have a feeling that the novelty of using it won’t wane, really helps you to interpret how system functioning.No hesitation in recommending this reputable company
Fantastic company to deal with.* Easy quote and payment methods* Punctual and Polite installers and salesmen* Great after install supportHave recommended to other people for install.

Polite, punctual, neat and completed on time. Customer service has been great and kept me in the loop. Abi from the sales team was very informative and was the only company rep to have a look at the roof and take measurements

The guys arrived and did the initial installation, worked well with our builders and had all the required safety gear.The final installation is very neat and tidy, all equipment is exactly where I asked it to be and all well marked.Communication throughout was excellent and the result is very good

I Want Energy did exactly what they said they would do, on time and as quoted, which to me is the key to excellent customer service. The very few questions I had post install were answered quickly and concisely. As an added bonus, their installation team was both ethnically and gender diverse. Well done!

A truly professional job. I was kept up to date the complete time. Instal was done on Friday and totally happy. As I already had the smart meter I was connected immediately and now generating my own supply. Everyone from I want energy and the  electrical team were very good at what they do. I have no hesitation in recommending them for solar.
The quote was the best we had, plus the most honest. The customer service from everyone was great. The installation went without any issues.
Installation from the actual quote to the installation was excellent.

I could not fault I want energy there quoting process was great the Sales person who came explained everything and was very professionalthe installation went very well still have to have the battery installedi have been told that I want Energy will help with the connection after everything is set upi really happy with there service recommend them to anyone and everyone

My initial equiry was met with a prompt call to facilitate a visit and meeting. Josh arrived, explained my options clearly and got the quote to me the next day. Once the quote was accepted the installation process was seamless with I Want Energy arranging all the paperwork with my energy provider and Claire (in the office) kept me abreast of progress on this front.  Tim duly arrived on the appointed day and carried out a quality and efficient installation.  No fuss, no mess and the system was fully operational the next day. Couldn't be happier, thanks to the team at I Want Energy.

They were the only company really interested in giving us an on-site discussion and quote not just a on line quote or video discussion. They were not the cheapest but had good equipment options to choose from and offered the best warranty and back up service.The installation was done earlier than expected by a team who were professional and considerate. They cleaned up after themselves and finished much earlier than expected.I would rate their service as excellent and they even organised the grid connection to be done before they left.Everything was up and running by early afternoon.

From the time I first contacted I Want Energy about the installation of solar panels on two properties in very different locations, the customer service experience was exceptional. The proposal developed for the solar panel installation was prepared with close and very informed consultations; I learnt a lot! And the installation of the panels was undertaken efficiently and in a very friendly manner. I’m very happy with the whole process and outcome.

Neither of us are engineers and had no knowledge about solar energy or how it works, but we felt it would be a good thing to do to save some money and to do our bit to help the planet.We got three quotes and Alex from I Want Energy was by far and away the most professional and took time to explain everything to us. We opted for a system with a slightly higher spec than the other companies suggested.The communication from Sarah and her customer service colleagues was great and we were very pleasantly surprised at the early install date.The installation team were also great. They arrived on time, were polite and friendly and tidied up after themselves!!Alex set me up with an app that shows how many kW our system is producing, how many we are using and how many we are sending to the grid - I know it's a bit geeky but I love it.I've saved the best bit to last: our first electricity bill: ELECTRICITY CHARGES = $86.47, SOLAR FEED-IN = $46.67, TO BE PAID = $39.80My wife and I are so pleased we went with Alex and I want Energy - as I said at the beginning, we made a great decision

After months of research we decided to deal with a reputable local company which had it's headquarters in Tasmania.From our initial contact, site visit and subsequent installation process our experience was nothing short of exceptional. In todays environment where time is important the communication process was precise detailed and accurate. We were well informed about the system components and the process that would be followed on the day of installation and beyond.The office staff and installation team kept us informed along the way and the quality of work was performed to a very high standard.We would certainly recommend I want Energy for your solar array design and installation.
Great customer service, responded quickly to my many queries. Highly Recommended

A quick instore quote using google earth provided an easy indication that this was an affordable move.One site visit and we were underway. A no fuss one day install and meter upgrade was all it took.All council approvals, Tas networks notifications and rebates taken care of. Would definitely suggest the hot water timer be included, big saving in power right there.I would recommend I Want Energy for any solar or electrical work without hesitationWayneHobart

This is what I wrote (unprompted) to I Want Energy:"I would like to say that I have been impressed with I Want Energy’s professionalism, efficiency and friendliness. It has been a pleasure to deal with you all. Sam was also friendly, efficient and informative, it has all been an enjoyable experience, Thank you."Highly recommended.
The sales person, office Staff and the installers they were all on the same page and with a similar goal (to have a great outcome for the customer) well done great job.

Both quotes were for similar hardware and were a similar price, but we went for I Want Energy, as their sales-person went to a lot of trouble to get the details right, and their layout was also the tidiest.The install was on the day specified. It was done neatly and tidily and the installers were polite and helpful.The work was inspected a few days after the install.It is now two weeks since the instal, and we are still waiting for Aurora to change the meter, so that we can go to go to Tariff 93.Update 8/5/2022:have only just had a chance to review our usage to date , using Sungrow's ISolarCloud app. Over the past 3 months,the Solar has provided abour 25% of our electricity usage. This probably not surprising, considering we have a household of seven, including 2 long-showering teenagers, who mostly shower at night, & who watch a lot of TV.We made the decision to switch from a General/Hot water tariff ot a Peak/Off Peak tariff. We haven't yet received our first bill since the installation. When it comes, I'll be able to see the balance between our Peak & Off-Peak usage & 'encourage' our family to shift as much as possible of our currently imported consumption into the Solar and Off-Peak time windows!

Listened to my requirements. While not achievable due to voltage drop limitations, proposed a suitable solution.Initial site survey was very thorough and all the members of the team were always approachable and willing to answer all my questions.

From my first contact inquiry there was a huge knowledge base, high tech remote sizing & an instant, easy to read multi choice quotation system.Polite & intelligent admin staff sorted install times & communication between the whole team.The install was completed on time smoothly & thoroughly by obviously experienced  professionals - no problems.I was contacted after the install to ask me if I had any questions which was appreciated.I Want Energy offered competitive pricing with premium gear & am very happy with the new system.These guys are by far the best in the country.

The process was very smooth. The sales person was excellent and helped us understand many parts of the industry and went beyond what he had to help us. I did get slightly confused by the numerous different people from the company I had to deal with and the numerous emails of information but I was given everything I needed. Highly recommend this supplier.
Professional installation carried out quickly. Quality panels and inverter providing expected output with performance monitoring via the Web and mobile app.

Very courteous, good communication from I Want Energy. and a good price with an itemized quote.We were very happy with the contracted installer.who communicated for the installation date, arrived on time, and was very neat with their work. Very happy to recommend this company.

The team at I want energy were very professional. Quoting was transparent showing us information on costing and quality across the market. Listened to our wants and answers questions well. Weren't rushed or too pushy.The install was done professionally as we asked and again all questions were answered to completion.Would highly recommend using I want energy for quoting and installing your solar
I had very good service from start to finishThankyou
The entire procedure was a very positive experience.I can highly recommend this company

Four suppliers were selected to provide quotes and information - all four were suitable. Difficult to differentiate although Finn's criteria proved helpful when ranking all four. Installation went well - on time, completed promptly and advice provided on next steps by both the installer and supplier. Grid connection outstanding at the time of preparing this review, Aurora have contacted me and this is being scheduled. I was informed on how to switch on the inverter and connect it to WiFi. WiFi demonstration was provided and looks promising.

We first installed solar panels, Fronius inverter, and a Tesla Powerwall with IWE a couple of years ago and this year decided to double the system - the sales advice and customer service was impeccable, we were especially grateful for the explanation for sourcing a different brand of panels due to uncertainty around the ethics of the original brand. On top of this, when global shipping impacted on the original agreement we were offered a free upgrade to both panels and inverter. Installation was a breeze (and was even done early!), also had a Tesla car charger installed and the guys were awesome. As return customers we are as happy the 2nd time as we were the 1st :)

Knowledgable and polite sales person made the quoting process informative and answered a few questions we had. The installation team were terrific; polite and punctual and did a fantastic job installing the entire system over two days due to bad weather. Follow up from customer service throughout the entire process was friendly, prompt and professional, including organising grid connection. Would highly recommend this installer.

Really impressed with the whole process. It took me a year to decide but there was no pressure. Excellent communication from the office and professional installers. Panels look fantastic on the roof. Highly recommend I Want Energy.
Original installer not available, so I want energy to the rescue. Prompt, efficient service to check and assess our system. Great work carried out by professional service technician.
Very happy with my system. Got exactly what I wanted and they made the whole process very easy.

A well organised process from start to finish. Initial quote, information on system choices, costs, time frame etc excellent.Installation was prompt, professional, pleasant experience.Cannot comment further as change of meters ran into snag as nobody had noticed that the backing board contains asbestos and now waiting for metering services for retailer to reschedule as technician on  initial date unable to complete.  Maybe something initial inspection could note?Glad I went with local firm, local employees.

The consulting and sales process was prompt and efficient without being pushy. The install happened as planned once we got past some terrible weather.  The install guys did a very nice job and had to contend with some additional work due to our second floor slab impinging on running cable but they sorted that with some additional drilling. With my OK they reworked my garage shelving to get the best fit for the new inverter and it looks very neat.  Everything I was told would happen has happened so all in all a great outcome.

No complaints the process from the start has been amazing.  Alex knows his products and will down with you and work our the best system for your household.  Installation was professional.  Definitely recommend.

From the initial consultation with the salesman (Mo Awais) to the process of pricing and installation a very pleasant experience indeed.The installers were prompt, courteous and efficient under extreme weather conditions.
Amazing!!  From start to finish.Awesome Work by All the Team at I Want Energy.Look No Further Than.........
The sales process was informative the installation was tidy and punctualThey organized the grid connection all was very easy

Although our system has not been installed as yet we have been nothing but happy with the professionalism of I want energy. Alex came to our house spent a good hour and a half explaining the pros and cons of solar. He got on the roof with me and we discussed several options for our east west north roof. I have no doubt that the installation will be flawless and that the company will be there for the long term. After the install I will post an update.

This upgrade of my tired and old 1.6kWh system to a 5.2kWh system went like clockwork. I have used I Want Energy a number of times, they are the consummate professionals and give excellent value for money.

I Want Energy - professional, knowledgeable with a friendly service.The team were very easy to deal with, always approachable and happy to explain any detail we may have been unsure of!Installers with were prompt and did a fantastic job.Would recommend this company to anyone looking to install solar power. We are really happy with our end result!

This was my second attempt at Solar after a massive failure from another company. Iwantenergy were fantastic, their quote process was very thorough including getting up on the roof to take measurements. Abi was very friendly and provided the information I needed. The installers arrived on time, and battled the wind to get the job done. The install is very neat and is exactly how I wanted it. There was a slight panel position change required on the day and the installers worked with the office to ensure I was happy with this change. Another standout is the communication from the office. Their processes are down pat ensuring information is received throughout the process.

Mo from I Want Energy was very thorough with his quotes and in answering any questions I had. The whole process was easy to navigate.  The installers were punctual, quick (even in the rain) and neat.I would happily recommend both.
Rob looked after the whole process from start to finish.The install went perfectly.

Everything was clearly explained and questions answered at first contact. Installation was quick and efficient by personable tradesmen. The quote for the s@ inns we would make is proving to be accurate and we are very pleased with the outcome.
When the sun shines we are delighted with the way everything works. Would not hesitate to recommend this Hobart based company as both friendly, helpful and efficient.

For many years I have been trying to decide whether to go solar or not but in 2020 I decided it was time.  After a talking to a number of companies on what they had to offer we decided to go with I Want Energy.  Their middle of range quote was reasonable so it was a yes go ahead.  The installation went along without any great issues. The operation of the solar inverter was explained in easy to understand ways.  The changes to tariffs were completed in a timely manner by I Want Energy.  After a few little hiccups it would appear all is going along fine.  Our monthly power bills are a lot less than what they have been in the past. The few questions I have had over the last six months have been answered quickly.

The experience we had was the very best from start to finish and with follow up service since the installation we can only say these guys and girls are fantastic We highly recommend I Want Energy Alex our consultant deserves a massive pay rise.

Quoting process was very informative - a number of options well presented including hardware choices and arrangement on roof- i think use of pylon software made this easier - 3 different quote occurred on site, were discussed and one agreed on that suited my budget and concerns re: equipment manufacture origins - a much smoother process than those sales people from other firms who said - "yep, we'll get a quote to you tomorrow" and nothing was ever heard! or a cut n paste job that wasn't appropriate and informative enough. Information photos etc were gathered by the rep that made the installers' process easier.Installers were on time, efficient and no-fuss. Clean tidy work. I looked at 5 different companies before selecting I Want Energy to supply and install my rooftop solar system. To be fair they were all friendly and offered 2-3 different systems with quotes. I could not have made an obvious choice between them all. What put IWE above the rest in my considerations was the attention to detail. They were the only company where the salesman went up on the roof to check load capacity, anchorage placement and which roof real-estate got the sun at different times of the day. He then asked what part of the day did we think our energy use was highest. Based on this and a cursory inspection of our previous energy bills he advised a spread of panels across our multi-level/angle roof to maximise our energy collection at the times of day when we would use it. As he explained to us, using your free energy is always going to be more valuable than selling it back to the grid at a reduced rate. Every other company had just advised putting the panels where the maximum solar capture would be. By this different placement we are able to harness the sun’s free energy throughout the day and have noticed a considerable difference in our bills. We were also given a choice of brands for the panel and inverter and we went with a more expensive panel but there was no pushy ness on the part of the salesman on this. We just knew what we wanted. The installers were fast and efficient. The follow-up was friendly and courteous.  I would have no hesitation in recommending IWE for anyone’s solar energy needs. In fact I already have.
